many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

pts=[(1,6),(3,7),(5,0),(5,7),(9,2),(12,2),(12,4),(17,6),(20,7),(21,5)]
import math
fills=set(); pairs=[]
for i,p in enumerate(pts):
 for q in pts[i+1:]:
  dr=q[0]-p[0]; dc=q[1]-p[1]; g=math.gcd(abs(dr),abs(dc))
  if g>1:
   seg=[(p[0]+k*(dr//g),p[1]+k*(dc//g)) for k in range(1,g)]
   if seg:
    fills.update(seg); pairs.append((p,q,seg))
print('fills', sorted(fills)); print('pairs',pairs)
# build grid
G=[[8]*8 for _ in range(30)]
for r,c in pts:G[r][c]=7
for r,c in fills:
 if G[r][c]==8:G[r][c]=3
print('\n'.join('['+', '.join(map(str,row))+'],' for row in G))
